triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

First touch (R1205, 22:5xZ): **p2 · domain:skills** → `pm:queue`.

Theme: MCP / 问数 (epic #34659). One skill row tells the client what to do after the user answers an ask-back. It supports the asked-back target of the p1 loop #34996, but on its own it has no direct customer effect, so p2.

triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

**Regraded p2 → p1: an MCP ask-line card.** The maintainer ranked the ask line first (「代码搭建已经可用，只是优化，mcp问数优先，其次是mcp搭建」, #34659 comment 6972918775). In triage's session he then agreed that the open cards under the ask parents #35150 and #35159 rise to p1 (「问数专题已按你的顺序重排 同意」). The MCP build and code-first lines stay p2. Any claim on the card is unchanged.

triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

**Regraded p1 → p2: the 09:2xZ raise is reverted.** The maintainer, in triage's session: 「p1 是不是应该留给真的需要插队的」, then 「把刚才提到 p1 的 7 张问数卡改回 p2」. The order of epic #34659's work comes from the epic's own structure (the ask line #35150/#35159 first), not from priority labels. p1 is kept for cards that must jump ahead of epic work. Any claim on the card is unchanged.
